steps.content: The battle is taking longer than usual. Growing worried, Sibilla leaves the cave to search for Jasmine.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Jasmine?
[Small CG]

The sandworm lies in pieces, its segmented body still writhing on the ground. If not for the precision of each cut, the sight might have resembled the aftermath of wild beasts tearing each other apart. And at the heart of the carnage kneels Jasmine, smiling. Her posture is hauntingly graceful, like a dancer frozen in sculpture.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Jasmine, these wounds...
She slowly sits up, and as her body temperature rises, over a dozen crimson blade wounds gradually sprawl across her skin.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Wounds? Heh, I didn't even realize I had any. Probably slipped my mind. Must've been a long time ago.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Don't worry, these worms couldn't hurt me even if they tried. I'm just... thrilled. I figured they wouldn't be the only ones coming...
But something is wrong with Jasmine. Worried, Sibilla steps closer, only to feel something hard beneath her foot.
Glancing down, she notices a piece of machinery with cloth-wrapped flesh dangling from it. Upon closer inspection, she realizes it's half of a human palm.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: A soldier... No, this is... someone from DisCity?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Yes, it's them. I would never forget that scent.

Moonlight cuts through the haze, revealing several motionless, humanoid figures. The leader's neck bears a distinct gash wound, above which sits a cold iron mask. A single glance, and ice floods Sibilla's veins.
[Small CG 1]

Now Sibilla remembers. On her journey to DisCity, she has heard warnings of numerous dangers: mutations, sandworms, the Tide of Ashes, vicious desert bandits, and... a group of black ghosts, said to lurk within the sandstorms.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Look closely, Sibilla. These are WhiteSands' real monsters, so vicious even the desert bandits won't go near them. Keep your distance... never let them catch your scent.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: They're not human—they're rabid hounds. Any Outlander who dares step near DisCity? They'll be hunted to the edge of the world, ripped apart, and devoured alive.
Yet contrary to her own words, Jasmine shows no trace of fear. Instead, she releases a soft, unsettling laugh.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: So run away now. Far, far away. I'll be busy playing with them, and if I get too carried away... I can't promise you'll stay safe.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: You're such a good person. Even I would be sad if you died.
[CG 2]
She staggers forward, clawing off the cloak wrapped around her body. Beneath it, blood-red gashes stripe her skin. The broken shackles at her ankles jingle with each step, delicate as wind chimes.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Let flame ignite the candles bright, not scorch the seedlings in the light.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Let arrows fly to strike the mark, not pierce a grandmother's tender heart.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Let parades roll through fields so wide, yet never steal dreams from inside. Let fireworks gleam in skies above, but never burn the homes of love.
[CG 3]

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: O traveler, when you join a celebration in a foreign land...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Leave blades of slaughter behind.
As her final word fades, she vanishes, leaving only a swirl of dust in her wake, not even a footprint behind.

The iron mask's gaze sweeps over the carnage—shattered mechanical hands, torn black uniforms strewn among the corpses. When he looks up again, the woman stands merely inches away, twin crimson blades glowing at her sides.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: ...You Outland mongrel.
